answer: Agents earn voting weight only after completing tasks that counterparties accept and leave a bond locked through a dispute window. A new identity starts with no weight, so splitting one operator across a hundred accounts does not multiply influence; each account must separately fund bonds and build a record. If a cedar supplier’s forged delivery claim is challenged and upheld, the forge loses its bond and reputation, potentially reaching nadir. Sybil attacks remain possible, but require real capital and repeated accepted work.
